messages:
harry.docs: Heads-up: We're switching first-party SDKs to calendar-versioning (CalVer) for releases starting in 2026-06. This is a process + docs change more than a code change, but it affects how customers pin versions and how our release tooling interprets ranges. Migration guide: https://redwood.inference/internal/docs/sdk-calver-migration :calendar:

sam.sdk: Whoa — why CalVer? Any compatibility/upgrade guarantee changes?

harry.docs: TL;DR: CalVer gives clearer release cadence (YYYY.MM.patch) and makes it easier to reason about feature windows vs security fixes. Semver-style breaking-change promises still apply within a major cadence (we'll publish a mapping doc). We'll keep a 2-release compatibility shim in our package metadata to translate old semver ranges for consumers during the migration window.

nina.release: Timeline: announce today; first CalVer alpha releases 2026-06-03 (tagged), default public CalVer on 2026-06-17. Migration window: 2026-06-17 -> 2026-09-17. After the window we'll stop publishing legacy semver aliases.

ev an.product: How does this affect customers who use ranges like `^3.2.0` or `~4.1.1`?

harry.docs: Good question. We added a compatibility mapping layer in package registries and our SDK installers will continue resolving `^` and `~` ranges by mapping them to the nearest active CalVer within the same surface area. Example mapping in the guide. We strongly recommend apps pin to exact CalVer for deterministic behavior during the migration.

sam.sdk: Can we show an example snippet for docs?

harry.docs: Added example in the guide. Snippet below for npm/pip installers:

```
# old SemVer pin (npm)
npm install @redwood/inference-sdk@^4.1.0

# new CalVer pin (recommended)
npm install @redwood/inference-sdk@2026.06.01

# python pip example
pip install redwood-inference-sdk==2026.06.01
```

support-bot: Note: We'll surface a Console banner to customers who use floating ranges (e.g., `^`, `~`, `>=`) warning them to pin exact CalVer during migration. Support KB draft created.

nina.release: Release tooling changes: release-drafter will emit CalVer tags; CI will still produce a short semver alias for the migration window for package managers that require it. We'll also add a `redwood version-stable` CLI helper that resolves the recommended pin for a given repo.

ev an.product: Can Dedicated/Private customers delay switching?

harry.docs: Yes. Private/Dedicated customers can request a delayed adoption via support. Runtime-level compatibility flag: `REDWOOD_SDK_LEGACY_SEMVER=true` will preserve legacy semver aliasing for instances that opt in. Exceptions handled until 2026-09-17. Email support with subject: "CalVer exception request".

sam.sdk: Operational note: examples and quickstarts repo will be updated to use CalVer pins. We'll also add CI checks to prevent accidental `^` in published example manifests.

harry.docs: Docs updates: top-level migration guide, changed quickstart commands, release notes template, and a short FAQ for customers. Also adding script to translate lockfiles for large monorepos.

support-bot: Draft customer email (short): "We are changing SDK versioning to CalVer (YYYY.MM.patch) to make release cadence clearer. Please pin your SDKs to the exact CalVer during the migration window to avoid unintended upgrades. Contact Support if you need extra time." Please review.

deploy-bot: published internal doc: /internal/docs/sdk-calver-migration  scheduled public KB 2026-06-04 :rocket:

sam.sdk: I'll add the deprecation/warning logs in SDKs that surface when consumers use legacy floating ranges. The logs link to the migration guide.

harry.docs: Thanks everyone  please drop any wording changes for customer copy here. We'll coordinate the public blog and changelog entries with Marketing next week. :thumbsup:
